dialect.detail: JMA ORCA medical receipt software (JMA standard receipt software), compiled with GnuCOBOL/OpenCOBOL on Linux. Uses .INC copybooks with REPLACING, INDEXED files with DYNAMIC/SEQUENTIAL access, typical of the ORCA project codebase.
evidence: SELECT ... ASSIGN ... ORGANIZATION IS INDEXED ACCESS MODE IS DYNAMIC

purpose.domain_detail: Japanese medical insurance receipt (レセプト) processing system - monthly business receipt detail file creation and point aggregation for outpatient/self-pay billing
purpose.summary: ORCR0420 is a batch program in the JMA ORCA medical receipt system that creates monthly business receipt detail files and aggregates diagnostic category point counts for outpatient and self-pay receipts. It reads and writes multiple indexed ISAM files (RECE41, RECE44, RECE45, RECE4A, RECE4B) and produces an error file. The program has an extensive revision history spanning 2002-2007 covering Japanese medical fee revisions.

notable_features: 35 COPY statements with REPLACING for copybook reuse
Multiple INDEXED files with both DYNAMIC and SEQUENTIAL access modes on same physical file
No EXEC SQL or EXEC CICS
177 PERFORM statements indicating structured procedural decomposition
Extensive Japanese-language comments (EUC-JP encoded, decoded as latin-1)
Long revision history with version numbers (01.00.01 through 03.05.03)
Error file (RECEERR) for output error logging
FLG-AREA with numerous processing flags for medical billing categories
verdict.notes: Source comments are in Japanese EUC-JP encoding, decoded here as latin-1 causing mojibake in the displayed text. The file is part of the well-known open-source JMA ORCA project for Japanese medical insurance claim processing. Max line length 79 and long_lines_over_72=64 confirms fixed-format COBOL with occasional overflow into columns 73-79 (likely sequence numbers or continuation).
